description: This Java class 'PressVibratorV29' extends 'PressVibratorV26' and manages device-specific vibration effects for Android API level 29. It handles setting vibration durations, using system-defined vibrations, and executing vibrations based on user interactions like long presses.

classes.name: PressVibratorV29
classes.description: A device-specific vibrator class for API level 29, managing vibration effects and system haptic settings.

methods.name: setDuration
methods.description: Sets the duration of the vibration, creating a one-shot vibration effect if system vibration is not used.

methods.name: setLongPressDuration
methods.description: Sets the duration for long press vibrations, creating a one-shot effect if system vibration is not used.

methods.name: setUseSystemVibration
methods.description: Configures whether to use system-defined vibrations and haptic feedback, updating internal vibration effects accordingly.

methods.name: vibrate
methods.description: Triggers the vibration, respecting system haptic settings.
